name: Phase 7: Generic Ship Cargo Model
description: Tests for data-driven cargo system: generic ship_cargo table, holds enforcement across all commodity types, legacy column synchronization.

commands.description: Ensure commodities table has standard set
commands.sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('ORE', 'Ore', false, 100, 20) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('ORG', 'Organics', false, 150, 30) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('EQU', 'Equipment', false, 200, 25) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('COL', 'Colonists', false, 500, 15) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('SLV', 'Slaves', true, 1000, 50) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('WPN', 'Weapons', true, 750, 40) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('DRG', 'Drugs', true, 500, 60) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

commands.description: Create test player with specific alignment
commands.sql: INSERT INTO players (name, status, sector_id, alignment, experience, credits) VALUES ('testplayer_good', 'active', 1, 5000, 1000, 100000) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET status='active', sector_id=1, alignment=5000, credits=100000 RETURNING player_id;

commands.description: Create test ship for good player (150 holds)
commands.sql: INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, holds, sector_id, player_id, attack, shields, installed_shields, fighters, genesis, limpets, mines, beacons, colonists, equipment, organics, ore, slaves, weapons, drugs, cloaking_devices) SELECT 'test_ship_good', 1, 150, 1, player_id, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 100, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM players WHERE name='testplayer_good' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING ship_id;

tests.name: Holds enforcement: legal cargo fills exactly to capacity
tests.description: Add 100 ORE + 50 ORG to 150 hold ship, verify total equals holds and further additions fail

steps.note: ERR_HOLD_FULL = 2000; adding 1 to full 150-hold ship should fail

tests.name: Holds enforcement: illegal cargo counts toward total
tests.description: Fill holds with legal cargo, attempt to add illegal cargo, verify ERR_HOLD_FULL

steps.note: Attempt to add illegal drug should fail with ERR_HOLD_FULL

tests.name: Mixed cargo sum: legal + illegal commodities count together
tests.description: Add various commodity types, verify total is enforced correctly

steps.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_mixed'); DELETE FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_mixed'; INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, holds, sector_id, player_id, attack, shields, installed_shields, fighters, genesis, limpets, mines, beacons, colonists, equipment, organics, ore, slaves, weapons, drugs, cloaking_devices) SELECT 'test_ship_mixed', 1, 200, 1, player_id, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 100, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM players WHERE name='testplayer_good';

tests.name: Legacy sync: ship_cargo changes reflect in ships.* columns
tests.description: Modify ship_cargo, call sync_legacy_columns, verify ships.ore/organics/equipment etc updated

steps.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_legacy_sync'); DELETE FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_legacy_sync'; INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, holds, sector_id, player_id, attack, shields, installed_shields, fighters, genesis, limpets, mines, beacons, colonists, equipment, organics, ore, slaves, weapons, drugs, cloaking_devices) SELECT 'test_ship_legacy_sync', 1, 150, 1, player_id, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 100, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM players WHERE name='testplayer_good';

steps.note: Legacy columns should reflect ship_cargo totals

tests.name: Regression: commodity trading still works
tests.description: Trade commodities at port, verify cargo is updated correctly via API

steps.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_trade'); DELETE FROM ships WHERE name='test_ship_trade'; INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, holds, sector_id, player_id, attack, shields, installed_shields, fighters, genesis, limpets, mines, beacons, colonists, equipment, organics, ore, slaves, weapons, drugs, cloaking_devices) SELECT 'test_ship_trade', 1, 150, 1, player_id, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 100, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM players WHERE name='testplayer_good';

steps.note: Verify legacy column reflects final state

teardown.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name LIKE 'test_ship%'); DELETE FROM ships WHERE name LIKE 'test_ship%'; DELETE FROM players WHERE name LIKE 'testplayer%';
